status: SOURCE-CONFIRMED FIRST ENCYCLOPEDIA TRANCHE / FURTHER CORPUS EXTRACTION OPEN
editorial_law: Preserved Zubaida transmissions are evidence. These dossiers add structure and explanation without replacing source text. Unknowns remain explicit.
archarthitean_rank_law: For Top-50 clans, Archarthiteanhood is rank-contingent under current user canon: the clan leader and direct descendants are Archarthitean while the clan qualifies; rank loss causes demotion and loss of Archarthitean abilities while completed results persist; restoration occurs if the leader returns the clan to the Top 50.

discovery_audit.method: 128-message sender index anchored; clan/name discovery searches across the sender corpus; ZUB-001 entity metadata used as a discovery aid; direct full-source reads used for clan-heavy transmissions. Only source-confirmed named clans are published in v0.1. Exhaustive claim-level 118-source extraction remains open.
discovery_audit.classification_rule: A group is marked as a clan only when the source explicitly calls it a clan or the existing canonical clan dataset is supported by direct Zubaida clan evidence. Governing bodies and institutions are not converted into clans merely because they interact with clans.
discovery_audit.manifest_status: The upstream zubaida-index.json contains 128 sender-message IDs while its audit classifies 118 as source-bearing and 10 as non-source/admin/reply-shell records. CLAN-001 v0.1 therefore does not mislabel the 128-ID sender list as the 118-source subset; exact source-bearing classification reconciliation remains open before FINISHED status.

clans.name: Redalious Clan
clans.rank_evidence: Attested #1 among the Top 10 clans in the June 17 Talmorai ranking snapshot; razor-thin gap over Unmatara.
clans.purpose: Heavy kinetic war, Ke'enmon performance and endurance-led military supremacy.
doctrine: Convert extreme war pressure into escalating endurance and war-factor growth.
Use proxy wars and branch-clan recursion as comparative proof of superiority rather than relying on inherited prestige.
structure: Main clan under Dyvane with recursively deep branch clans created through Benzshin.
Members can move toward or away from the main clan according to merit; poor relative performance can result in deeper branch placement.
performance: Ranked #1 in the cited clan snapshot, under constant pressure from Unmatara.
Dyvane ranked #3 in Divine Power and #3 in Kafai in the same snapshot.
Proxy-war wins generate clan merit, alter Imarq intensity and accelerate PHk feedback through stress.
members: Dyvane Redalious — clan leader and Male War Supreme General
relationships: Primary kinetic-war rival: Unmatara Clan.
Cold-war counterpart system: Vaeloria and Xylaris operate in Talmorai while Redalious/Unmatara dominate Ke'enmon kinetic war.
training: Sehexi / extreme pressure systems in broader Top-50 doctrine
unknowns: A complete current branch roster and exact present-day rank after later canon changes are not yet established.

symbol.alt: A fortified shield split by a central vertical bastion line
symbol.rationale: The shield and central bastion represent endurance, fortification, kinetic-war anchoring and the clan's role as a top Ke'enmon military benchmark.

performance: #2 clan in cited snapshot and repeatedly described as nearly level with Redalious.
Qintara ranked #4 Divine Power and #4 Kafai in that snapshot.
The clan's proxy-war rivalry is used to maximize volatility, effort and hereditary improvement.
members: Qintara Unmatara — clan leader and Female War Supreme General

symbol.alt: A spear-like upward vector crossing a diamond shockfront
